questions.question: Which of the following was NOT a goal of the Five-Year Plans?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Security.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Five-Year Plans** were a series of economic plans implemented in the** Soviet Union **between **1928 and 1991,** aimed at developing the country's economy.
 
• The goals of the plans were to achieve rapid **industrialization, **increase **agricultural production**, improve **transportation and communication **infrastructure, and develop the country's natural resources.
 
• **Self-reliance** was a key goal of the plans, as the **Soviet Union** wanted to reduce its dependence on foreign imports and technology.
 
• **Equity **was also a** goal**, as the Soviet Union aimed to reduce income inequality and provide basic necessities to all citizens.
 
• **Growth **was a **central goal**, as the plans aimed to increase the country's GDP and improve living standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Security was **not** a stated goal of the Five-Year Plans, although it could be argued that the plans were aimed at strengthening the** Soviet Union's military and geopolitical power.**
 
• Other goals of the plans included **improving education** and **healthcare,** promoting **cultural development**, and advancing **science and technology.**
 
• The Five-Year Plans were** controversial,** as they often involved forced labor, collectivization of agriculture, and suppression of dissent.
 
• Despite their flaws, the plans did lead to significant industrial and technological advancements in the Soviet Union, but also contributed to** environmental degradation and economic inefficiencies.**

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of the negative effects of the green revolution?

options.text: Primarily medium and large farmers were able to benefit from the new technology of the green revolution.
The green revolution benefited farmers who had access to land, capital, technology and know-how.
The green revolution led to the displacement of tenant cultivators in many cases.
The green revolution caused increased migration from urban to rural areas.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**green revolution caused increased migration from urban to rural areas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Green revolution:-**

 
 
• **The green revolution was a period of technological advancement in agriculture that began in the 1940s and continued until the 1970s.**
 
• **The green revolution was mainly focused on increasing the productivity of high-yielding crops such as wheat, rice, and maize.**
 
• **The green revolution was successful in increasing crop yields and reducing food insecurity in many parts of the world, particularly in Asia and Latin America.**
 
• Primarily medium and large farmers were able to benefit from the new technology of the green revolution. This statement is true as the green revolution was mainly focused on increasing the productivity of high-yielding crops, which required a certain level of investment and resources that small farmers could not afford.
 
• The green revolution benefited farmers who had access to land, capital, technology, and know-how. This statement is also true as the green revolution required a certain level of resources and infrastructure to be successful, and farmers who had access to these resources were able to benefit from it.
 
• The green revolution led to the displacement of tenant cultivators in many cases. This statement is also true as the green revolution led to the consolidation of landholdings and the displacement of small farmers and tenant cultivators who could not compete with the larger farmers.

questions.question: Which period in India is described as Plan Holiday?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1966 to 1969 **__which is described as Plan Holiday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plan Holiday:-**

 
 
• **The period from 1966 to 1969 in India is known as the Plan Holiday because during this time the government put a pause on the Five-Year Plans that had been implemented since independence.**
 
• The Plan Holiday was a result of the economic crisis faced by India due to two consecutive years of drought and the Indo-Pak War of 1965.
 
• During this period, the government focused on stabilizing the economy and implementing policies to promote self-sufficiency.
 
• The Plan Holiday was followed by the Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974) which focused on poverty alleviation and employment generation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Period of 1990 to 1993:- **

 
 
• It refers to the period when India faced a balance of payment crisis and the government implemented economic reforms under the leadership of then-Finance Minister Manmohan Singh. 
 
 
 
• **Period of 1956 to 1960:-**
 
 
• It was the Second Five-Year Plan period which focused on industrialization and agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Period of 1947 to 1950:-**
 
 
• It was the immediate post-independence period when the government focused on reconstruction and development.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Industrial Policy resolution 1956?

I. This resolution formed the basis of the Second Five Year Plan.

II. This policy was used for promoting industry in backward regions.
questions.solution:
Te correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) 1956

__
 
• Adopted to achieve the aim of a socialist state with the government controlling the major strategic industries of the economy.
 
• According to this resolution, industries were classified into the following three categories:
 
 
• Category 1: Those industries that were established and owned exclusively by the public sector.
 
• Category 2: Those industries in which the public sector would perform the primary role while the private sector would play the secondary role i.e., the private sector supplements the public sector In these industries and new units could be set up only by the public sector.
 
• Category 3: Those industries that are not included in Category 1 and Category 2 were left to the private sector.
 
• The government kept indirect control of the industries in the private sector through the policy of industrial licensing.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Highlights of IPR 1956:__
 
• In order to initiate a new industry or expand existing capacity, private entrepreneurs were supposed to obtain licenses from the government.
 
• Licensing, imposition of the tax, tax exemptions, and subsidies were used by the government:
 
 
• to regulate private industries.
 
• bring about a reduction in regional disparities in industrial development. 
 
• to keep a check on the production of goods that are socially undesirable.
 
 
 
• Hence, the government fully controlled the private sector either directly or Indirectly through the IPR 1956.

questions.question: Which of the following years were considered plan holidays in Independent India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1966 - 1969.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Period:** Plan Holidays occurred from 1966 to 1969.
 
• **Reason:** The failure of the Third Five-Year Plan due to economic crises like wars and drought.
 
• **Focus:** Emphasis was placed on agriculture and price stabilization instead of long-term planning.
 
• **Result:** Short-term plans were implemented to address immediate economic issues before resuming regular Five-Year Plans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Context:** The Plan Holidays were introduced after the Third Five-Year Plan (**1961–1966**) failed to meet its objectives due to multiple setbacks like the Indo-China War (1962), Indo-Pak War (1965), and severe droughts in **1965** and **1966**.
 
• **Economic Impact:** These events caused food shortages, inflation, and a balance of payments crisis, forcing the government to temporarily halt long-term planning.
 
• **Interim Plans:** During the Plan Holidays, the government implemented Annual Plans focusing on critical sectors like agriculture, irrigation, and employment creation to stabilize the economy.
 
• **Resumption:** The Fourth Five-Year Plan (**1969–1974**) resumed after these Plan Holidays, aiming to promote growth and self-reliance in the economy.

questions.question: Usually, which year of a series of years in an economic index is called the base year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**First Year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A base year is the** first of a series of years **in an economic or financial index.
 
• New,** up-to-date base years are periodically introduced** to keep data current in a particular index.
 
• **Any year can serve as a base year,** but analysts typically choose recent years.
 
• Base year re**fers to the base point in the time of a time series.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Economic Index is a **statistical measure of change in a representative group of individual data points.**
 
• These data may be derived from **any number of sources, including company performance, prices, productivity, and employment**.

questions.question: Which of these was NOT one of the reasons for the break in the five year plans after three consequent five year plans were formulated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the__** Gulf War.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's government formulated five-year plans to set targets for economic growth and development over five years.
 
• The first five-year plan was launched in 1951, and subsequent procedures were formulated until the 12th five-year plan ended in 2017.
 
• ** The break in five-year plans occurred after three consequent plans were formulated - the 7th, 8th, and 9th five-year plans.**
 
• The reasons for the break were primarily domestic issues such as the **Indo-Pakistan conflict, the devaluation of domestic currency, and two successive years of drought.**
 
• The Gulf War, which took place in 1990-91, impacted the global economy but was not a direct cause of the break in five-year plans in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Five-Year Plans:

__
 
• The idea of a five-year plan is simple- The Government of India prepares a document with all its income and expenditure for five years.
 
• The budget of the central government and all the state governments is divided into two parts: non-plan and plan budgets.
 
• The non-plan budget is spent on routine items yearly. The planned budget is spent on a five-year basis as per the priorities fixed by the plan.
 
• The model of the Indian economy was premised on the concept of planning based on** five-year plans from 1951 to 2017.**
 
• The Five Year Plans were formulated, implemented, and regulated by a body known as the Planning Commission.

 
 

 Plan
 Aim/Goal
 
 

 First
 economic development
 
 

 Second
 rapid industrialization and the public sector
 
 

 Third
 agriculture development and growth
 
 

 Fourth
 Growth, Stability, and self-reliance.
 
 

 Fifth
 employment and poverty alleviation
 
 

 Sixth
 economic liberation 
 
 

 Seventh
 Industrial productivity levels through the use of technology
 
 

 Eighth
 modernisation of Industries
 
 

 Ninth
 elimination of poverty 
 
 

 Tenth
 inclusive growth and equitable development

 rapid and more inclusive growth
 
 

 Twelfth
 Faster, More Inclusive, and Sustainable Growth
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** 

Indo-Pakistan conflict:**

__
 
• The Indo-Pakistan conflict refers to the tensions and conflicts between India and Pakistan, primarily over the disputed region of Kashmir.
 
• The conflict has had an impact on India's economy and has been a factor in the break-in of five-year plans due to the diversion of resources towards defense and security.

**Devaluation of domestic currency:**

 
• Devaluation of domestic currency refers to reducing the currency's value relative to other currencies.
 
• This can lead to inflation and other economic problems, which can impact the targets set in the five-year plans.
 
• The devaluation of the Indian rupee in the 1990s was a factor in the break-in five-year plans.

**Two successive years of drought:**__

 
• Droughts can have a significant impact on agriculture, which is a major sector of the Indian economy.
 
• Two successive years of drought can lead to food shortages, inflation, and other economic problems, which can impact the targets set in the five-year plans.
 
• The droughts in the mid-1960s were a factor in the break in five-year plans.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct about the Five-Year Plan?

options.text: All Five-Year Plans have equal rates of growth.

The President was the ex-officio chairperson of the Planning Commission.
The first Five-Year Plan was started in 1951.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**the first Five-Year Plan was started in 1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first Five-Year Plan** was started in **1951**.
 
• The Five-Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs initiated by the Government of India.
 
• The primary aim was to achieve specific economic goals and promote balanced growth.
 
• The **Planning Commission, established in 1950**, was responsible for formulating these plans.
 
• While the first Five-Year Plan focused on agricultural development, subsequent plans targeted various sectors such as industry, education, and health.
 
• The Planning Commission was replaced by the **NITI Aayog in 2015**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Planning Commission** was an institution in the Government of India, which formulated India’s Five-Year Plans, among other functions.

questions.question: The global financial crises overlapped with which five-year plan in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Eleventh Five Year Plan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The **global financial crisis** that started in** 2008 **overlapped with the **Eleventh Five five-year plan **in India.
 
• The Eleventh Five Year Plan was implemented from **2007 to 2012**, and aimed to achieve** inclusive growth and development.**
 
• The global financial crisis had a significant impact on **India's economy**, leading to a slowdown in growth and affecting various sectors such as **exports, manufacturing, and finance.**
 
• The government of India implemented various measures to mitigate the impact of the crisis, such as **fiscal stimulus packages, monetary policy interventions, and structural reforms.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Ninth Five-Year Plan** was implemented from **1997 to 2002.**

 
 
• **​**The primary goals of the Ninth Five-Year Plan were to boost the **nation's economic growth** and address historical injustices.
 
 
 
• The** Tenth Five-Year Plan** was implemented from **2002 to 2007.**
 
 
• **​**The following are the Tenth Five-Year Plan's** primary goals:**
 
• Achieve annual **GDP growth of 8%.**
 
• **5% **decrease in the **poverty rate **by the year **2007.**
 
• supplying high-quality, rewarding work, at **minimum**, to the new labor force growth.
 
 
 
• The** Twelfth Five-Year Plan** was implemented from** 2012 to 2017.**
 
 
• **​**The Twelfth Plan's motto is **"Faster, More Sustainable, and More Inclusive Growth.**"
 
• The **National Development Council (NDC)** was the last body to grant the five-year plans formal approval.
